verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents some UI/API parity: traces can be filtered, exported, shared and compared "via the UI or API", and it ships Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs. Nothing documents that every UI capability (dashboards, alerts, annotation queues, rules, deployment management) is available programmatically, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an explicit claim of full UI/API parity, API coverage for dashboards, alerts, annotation queues and automation rules, a discoverable OpenAPI spec or API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs.
